title: BOOK BRAWL
subtitle: Big Nate vs. Diary of a Wimpy Kid

narr.name: Ian - Deep, Punchy Social Hook Voice

lines.say: [booming] Big Nate... versus... Diary of a Wimpy Kid!
[hyped] Tonight, we settle it. For good.
Greg is lazy, selfish, and throws his best friend under the bus... every single book.
cap: and throws his best friend under the {r:bus}...

lines.say: Nate's a troublemaker too. But he's got heart. He draws comics, goes all in, and wears his detention record like a trophy.
cap: and wears his {o:detention record} like a trophy.

lines.say: [dryly] So you're rooting against your own main character. Point, Big Nate.
Wimpy Kid has Rowley... and a bunch of punchlines. Big Nate has a whole school. Francis, Teddy, Gina, Mrs. Godfrey. Point, Big Nate.
Big Nate started as a daily newspaper comic. Setup, timing, punchline... for over thirty years.
cap: Big Nate started as a {o:daily newspaper comic}.

lines.say: [dryly] Sales measure popularity, not quality. Otherwise fast food would win every cooking show.
[building] So why do people still pick Wimpy Kid? Three reasons.
cap: So why do people still pick Wimpy Kid?

lines.say: One. Nostalgia goggles. You read it in third grade, and the Cheese Touch still lives rent-free in your head.
cap: You read it in third grade,
still lives rent-free in your head.

lines.say: Two. Reading comprehension. They see kid gets detention... and miss that every strip is a perfectly built joke.
Three. They read one Big Nate book from the school library... and never touched the comics.
cap: Three. They read {r:one} Big Nate book

bubbles.L03: [smug] Please. I sold, like, a bajillion copies.
bubbles.L04: [confident] Cool. I've been funny since nineteen ninety-one.
bubbles.L08: [defensive] Greg's supposed to be unlikable! That's the joke!
